dataset.method: Resolution of the Ministry of Transport and Communications No. 42 of 2026-08-24, in force from 2026-09-01, annex 1, table 1: EUR 0.121 per km for vehicles over 3.5 t with 2 axles, 0.152 with 3, 0.182 with 4 or more; BelToll counts the axles of the vehicle with its trailers and semi-trailers. Table 2 (not modelled): the rate times 10,0 on М-2 km 14,9-25,308, М-3 km 9,4-10,418, М-4 km 16,3-19,046, М-6/Е 28 km 12,0-20,575, Р-1 km 8,2-24,44, Р-23 km 10,2-14,1, Р-28 km 12,44-16,91 when a vehicle drives two or more of them within an hour. Toll roads: the list of the Regulation approved by Council of Ministers resolution No. 340 of 30 April 2013, placed on the ways OpenStreetMap tags as toll roads.
